title: Kodhano
text: 4 Pañcahi kho Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatim vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || 5 Assaddho ca hoti || ahiriko ca hoti || anottāpī ca hoti || kodhano ca hoti || duppañño ca hoti || || 6 Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyam duggatiṃ vinipātam nirayam upapajjatīti [page 241] XXXVII. 8. 6] PEYYĀLA-VAGGO PATHAMO 241 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || ||
